title: Single Cell High-Throughput qRT-PCR Protocol
author: Sirisha Achanta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bftdjni6
materials: RT Mix : To be prepared immediately prior to use in STEP 8. Mix the following reagents using the table below (Table 4) Volume for one sample (μl) Volumes for 96 samples with overage ( for 110 samples) (μl) 10X Superscript III Mix (VILO kit) 0.30 33 T4 Gene 32 Protein 0.20 22 DNA Suspension Buffer 1 110 Total 1.5 Add 1.5 µL of RT mix to each sample ( Table 4 ) Spin down for 00:02:00 at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler Thermocycler : RT 25 °C for 00:05:00 50 °C for 00:30:00 55 °C for 00:25:00 60 °C for 00:05:00 70 °C for 00:10:00 Hold at 4 °C Spin down for 00:02:00 at 2000 rpm and place on ice This is an optional stopping point. Samples can be stored overnight at 4 °C or stored at -20 °C for a year.

Exonuclease treatment: Add 8 µL of Exonuclease Mix ( reagent preparation ) to each sample Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler Thermocycler : Exonuclease 37 °C for 00:30:00 80 °C for 00:15:00 Hold at 4 °C Spin down for 00:02:00 at 2000 rpm andplace on ice Add 54 µL of TE buffer to each sample This is an optional stopping point. Samples can be stored overnight at 4 °C or stored at -20 °C for a year.

Vilo activation This step is prepared On ice Add 1.8 μl of 5X VILO Reaction Mix ( Component of Superscript VILO cDNA synthesis kit ) to each sample (unknown sample, positive control and negative control). Spin down for 00:02:00 at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler Thermocycler : VILO activation 65 °C – 00:01:30 Hold at 4 °C

Pre-amplification This step is performed on On ice Add 11.6 µL of PreAmp Mix to each sample Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler Thermocycler : PreAmp22 95 °C for 00:10:00 22 cycles of: 96 °C for 00:00:05 60 °C for 00:04:00 Hold at 4 °C Spin down for 00:02:00 at 2000 rpm and place on ice This is an optional stopping point. Samples can be stored overnight at 4 °C . We consider 22 cycles of pre-amp optimal for single cells collected using LCM. We do not recommended to pre-amplification of samples over 22 cycles due to observed increase in production of non-specific PCR fragments and primer-dimers.

Data Collection software settings: Double-click the Data Collection Software icon on the desktop to launch the software. Click Start a New Run . Check the status bar to verify that the lamp and the camera are ready. Make sure both are green before proceeding. Remove and discard the blue protective film from the bottom of the chip. Place the chip into the reader. Click Load . Verify chip barcode and chip type. Click Next . Chip Run file: Select New . Browse to a file location for data storage. Click Next . Application, Reference, Probes: Select Application Type-- Gene Expression for version 3.1.2 or higher software (for all earlier versions, contact Fluidigm Technical Support). Select Passive Reference: ROX . Select Probe-- Single probe . Select probe type: EvaGreen . Click Next . Click Browse to find the thermal cycling protocol file. For BioMark HD: GE Fast 48x48 PCR+Melt v2.pcl GE Fast 96x96 PCR+Melt v2.pcl

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Combine Lysis enhancer and Resuspension buffer (CellsDirect Kit). For one sample, use 0.5 μl Lysis enhancer and 5 μl Resuspension buffer (Total 5.5 μl). For 96 samples with overage (110 samples), use 55 μl Lysis enhancer and 550 μl Resuspension buffer (Total 605 μl).

substeps.instruction: Store Lysis Buffer at -20 °C for up to a year.

steps.title: Prepare RNA Dilution Series
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2X or 3X RNA dilution series for 6-8 dilution points using known amounts of RNA from whole tissue as a positive control and primer efficiency metric.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the mean sample input corresponds to the middle points of the series.
Example for single cell (approx. 10pg RNA) 2X series: 2pg/μl, 4pg/μl, 8pg/μl, 16pg/μl, 32pg/μl, and 64pg/μl.

steps.title: Prepare Primer Dilutions
steps.instruction: Order forward and reverse primers at 400 μM stock to obtain a 200 μM mix. Prepare the following dilutions:

substeps.instruction: 100 μM and 200 μM (forward and reverse primer mix) for pre-amplification.
20 μM (forward and reverse primer mix) for BioMark Chip loading.
2 μM for traditional qPCR.

steps.title: Prepare Primer Pool (500 nM)
steps.instruction: Generate a primer pool based on the number of primers:

substeps.instruction: For up to 200 primers: Mix 1 μl of each 100 μM primer pair with (200 - X) μl DNA Suspension Buffer (Total 200 μl).
For 201-400 primers: Mix 1 μl of each 200 μM primer pair with (400 - X) μl DNA Suspension Buffer (Total 400 μl).
Store primer pool at -20 °C for up to a year.

steps.title: Perform Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse cells using the following procedure (use tubes instead of LCM caps for cell culture samples):

substeps.instruction: Add 5.5 μL lysis buffer to the capture surface on the LCM Cap.
Cover the cap with a 0.2 ml tube, ensuring a tight seal.
Incubate at 75 °C on a heat block (cap surface in contact with block) for 15 minutes.
Cool cap and tube on ice for 5 minutes.
Spin down to collect lysate in the PCR tube and transfer to the cell lysate plate.

steps.title: Set Up Sample Plate
steps.instruction: On ice, prepare the PCR plate as follows:

substeps.instruction: Unknown samples: Transfer cell lysate to PCR plate. If using extracted RNA, transfer 1 μl of RNA (10-100pg) and add 4.5 μL lysis buffer.
Positive control: Transfer 1 μL of RNA standard and add 4.5 μL lysis buffer.
Negative control: Add 1 μL of molecular grade water and 4.5 μL lysis buffer.

steps.title: Prepare PreAmp Mix
steps.instruction: Immediately prior to use, mix the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: For one sample: 10 μl TaqMan PreAmp Master Mix and 1.6 μl 500 nM primer pool (Total 11.6 μl).
For 96 samples with overage (110 samples): 1100 μl TaqMan PreAmp Master Mix and 176 μl 500 nM primer pool.

steps.title: Prepare Exonuclease Mix
steps.instruction: Immediately prior to use, mix the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: For one sample: 0.8 μl 10X Exonuclease I reaction buffer, 1.6 μl Exonuclease I, and 5.6 μl DNA Suspension Buffer (Total 8 μl).
For 96 samples with overage (110 samples): 88 μl 10X Exonuclease I reaction buffer, 176 μl Exonuclease I, and 616 μl DNA Suspension Buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Chip Assay Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the assay plate (can be done one day prior and stored at 4 °C):

substeps.instruction: In a new PCR plate, aliquot 4 μL 2X Assay Loading Reagent into 48 or 96 wells based on the IFC BioMark chip layout.
Add 4 μL of corresponding primer pairs at 20 μM concentration to the wells.
Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Chip Sample Plate
steps.instruction: On the day of the chip run, prepare the sample plate:

substeps.instruction: Combine 2X SsoFast EvaGreen Supermix with Low ROX and 20X DNA Binding Dye Sample Loading Reagent:
For 48.48 IFC: 220 μl Supermix and 22 μl Dye (4 μl and 0.4 μl per inlet).
For 96.96 IFC: 440 μl Supermix and 44 μl Dye (4 μl and 0.4 μl per inlet).
Aliquot 4.4 μl of this mix into sample wells (96.96 IFC: A1 to H12; 48.48 IFC: wells 1 to 6 in each row A-H).
Add 3.6 μL of Exonuclease treated sample to the plate.
Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice.

steps.title: Prime and Load BioMark Chip
steps.instruction: Load the chip using the IFC Controller:

substeps.instruction: Inject control line fluid into each accumulator.
Place chip in IFC Controller MX (48.48) or HX (96.96) and run the Prime script (113x for 48.48; 136x for 96.96).
Eject the primed chip.
Pipette 5 μL of each assay and 5 μL of each sample into respective inlets.

Load columns using an 8-channel pipette: load column 1 (A1, B1..H1) in alternate wells starting top left; repeat for next 5 columns (96.96) or 2 columns (48.48). For the 7th (96.96) or 4th (48.48) column, start from the second well from the top.
Return chip to controller and run the Load Mix script (113x for 48.48; 136x for 96.96).
Remove chip and clean surface debris with scotch tape.

steps.title: Perform Traditional qPCR (Optional)
steps.instruction: Alternatively, measure samples using a traditional qPCR instrument with a 20 μl reaction mix:

substeps.instruction: Combine 2 μl Pre-amplified and Exonuclease treated sample, 2 μl Primer pair (2 μM), 10 μl TaqMan Universal PCR Master Mix, and 6 μl Molecular grade water.
Run a standard 30-35 cycle PCR.
